lines.japanese: 僕はいつも朝のホームルームの１５分ぐらい前に学校へ着く。
lines.english: I usually arrived at school around fifteen minutes before morning homeroom.

lines.japanese: この時間、まだ教室は四分の一ほどしか埋まってない。自分の席へ向かう途中、すれ違った同級生とは挨拶をしたりしなかったり。
lines.english: At that hour, barely a quarter of the classroom seats were occupied. On the way to my desk, I sometimes greeted the classmates I passed, and sometimes did not.

lines.japanese: バスケ部の鴻野君の手が、友達の肩をばしばし叩いた拍子に僕の肩にも当たった。彼が悪りー悪りーと謝ってくれたので、僕は笑顔で頭を下げておいた。
lines.english: Kono from the basketball team was slapping a friend on the shoulder and accidentally caught mine in the process. He apologized—sorry, sorry—so I bowed with a smile.

lines.japanese: その後ろでは甲高い声の女子グループが、きのう報じられた柳木原乱闘事件についてはやしたてていた。ああ、僕も気になってたから丁度いい。ちょっとその後の経過を聞いてみよう。ねえねえ君たち。
lines.english: Behind him, a shrill cluster of girls was loudly gossiping about yesterday’s report on the Yanagihara brawl. Ah, perfect. I had been curious about it too. I could ask what had happened since. Hey, girls.

lines.japanese: まさか。冗談だよ。
lines.english: As if. Just kidding.

lines.japanese: 僕は彼女たちの会話の邪魔にならないよう、自分の席まで一列分の遠回りをした。
lines.english: So as not to disturb their conversation, I made a detour of one whole row on my way to my seat.

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: *May peace prevail on Earth*.
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おはよ」
lines.english: “G-good morning.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。おはよう」
lines.english: “Mm. Good morning.”

lines.japanese: 一瞬、無視されたのかと思った。
lines.english: For a moment I thought she had ignored me.

lines.japanese: 「そうだ、きのうはごめん、ゲーム見に行くの付きあえなくて」
lines.english: “Oh, and I’m sorry about yesterday. I couldn’t go look at games with you.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……ううん、ぜんぜん。おかげでいいことあったから」
lines.english: “Oh… No, don’t worry about it. Something good came of it.”

lines.japanese: 「いいこと？」
lines.english: “Something good?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。ちょっとね」
lines.english: “Mm. A little something.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、探してたゲーム見つかったってこと？」
lines.english: “Oh, you found the game you were looking for?”
“Mm… what?”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　行ったんでしょ、ゲーム屋？」
lines.english: “You went to the game store, didn’t you?”

lines.japanese: 「や、だって私、きのうは隣りのクラスでずっと──」
lines.english: “No, yesterday I was in the classroom next door the whole time—”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、前後のことまで忘れちゃうんだあ」
lines.english: “Ohhh. You forget the parts before and after too.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは口の中でつぶやくように何か言った。聞きとれない。
lines.english: Watarai said something under her breath. I could not make it out.

lines.japanese: 「えー、すごーい。めっちゃべんりー」
lines.english: “Wow. Amazing. That’s incredibly convenient.”

lines.japanese: 「なに？　ごめん、ちょっと聞こえない」
lines.english: “What? Sorry, I couldn’t quite hear you.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、なんでもない」
lines.english: “Nothing. Never mind.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そう」
lines.english: “Oh. Okay.”

lines.japanese: 周囲からの視線が集中し始めたことに気がついて、僕にはそれ以上聞けなかった。
lines.english: I noticed people around us beginning to stare, and I could ask no more.

lines.japanese: 「……じゃあ」
lines.english: “…Well, then.”

lines.japanese: 「あい」
lines.english: “Yup.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんとの会話を終わらせて席に着いた。なんだかいつもより座席が狭い気がして落ちつかない。前の席がいつもより後ろに下がっている気がして、僕は机を少し引きよせた。
lines.english: I ended my conversation with Watarai and sat down. My seat somehow felt narrower than usual, which left me restless. The desk in front seemed to have been pushed backward toward me, so I drew my own desk a little closer.

lines.japanese: ああ、前にもこんなことがあった気がする。そういえば、あのときは森里君に会いに行こうとして──
lines.english: Ah. I felt as though this had happened before. Come to think of it, that time I had been about to visit Morisato—

lines.japanese: ──僕はケータイを開いて時刻を確かめた。うん、先生が来るまでまだ充分に間がある。ちょっと行ってみよう。
lines.english: —I opened my phone and checked the time. Yes, there was still plenty of time before the teacher arrived. I would go see him.

lines.japanese: 僕は体を横に捻って椅子から抜けだすと、後ろ側のドアから音も立てずに教室の外へ出た。
lines.english: I twisted sideways, slipped free of my chair, and left the classroom soundlessly through the rear door.

lines.japanese: 「あの、森里君いるかな」
lines.english: “Um, is Morisato here?”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　なに、聞こえねえよ」
lines.english: “Huh? What? Can’t hear you.”

lines.japanese: Ｈ組の廊下で、運良く昔のクラスメイトに会えた。確か彼は森里君とも仲が良かったはずだ。
lines.english: By luck I met an old classmate in the Class H corridor. If I remembered correctly, he and Morisato had been close.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、おまえ誰だっけ。えっと、一年トキいた──」
lines.english: “Hey, who were you again? Uh, you were with us first year—”

lines.japanese: 「うん、羽田。羽田鷹志」
lines.english: “Haneda. Takashi Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ！　そうそう、デリバリー羽田、よく和馬クンのパン買いに行ってた」
lines.english: “Oh, right! Delivery Haneda. You were always going out to buy bread for Kazuma.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 僕が彼の名前を覚えていなかったように、彼も僕を覚えていなかった。よくあることだ。
lines.english: Just as I had not remembered his name, he had not remembered me. It happened often.

lines.japanese: 「で、なんだって？」
lines.english: “So, what’d you want?”

lines.japanese: 「森里君。いたら呼んでほしいんだけど」
lines.english: “Morisato. If he’s here, could you call him?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　和馬？　森里に何の用なん？」
lines.english: “Huh? Kazuma? What do you want with Morisato?”

lines.japanese: 「とくに用ってわけじゃないけど、ちょっと話でもしたくて」
lines.english: “Nothing in particular. I only thought we might talk.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　あれ、へえ、そうなん？　森里と羽田クンってそんなカンジなん？　うそ、実はおトモダチっ？」
lines.english: “What? Huh. Seriously? You and Morisato are like that? No way—are you two actually friends?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。もちろん」
lines.english: “Of course.”

lines.japanese: どうしてか、彼は吹きだしそうだった。
lines.english: For some reason, he looked ready to burst out laughing.

lines.japanese: 「ああそう！　ぷぷっ、へえー、和馬クンも慕ってくれるトモダチがいて嬉しいだろうねえ」
lines.english: “Oh, sure! Pfft. Well, Kazuma must be thrilled to have a friend who admires him so much.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかな」
lines.english: “You think so?”

lines.japanese: 話しに来ただけで喜んでもらえるなら、僕だって嬉しい。男の友情、なんて改めて考えるとちょっと照れくさかった。
lines.english: If the mere fact that I had come to talk would make him happy, then I was happy too. Male friendship—thinking of it in those terms made me a little self-conscious.

lines.japanese: 「あーでも、残念ねえ、あいついま休んでて。知ってんでしょ、入院してるらしいよ」
lines.english: “Ah, but bad luck. He’s absent right now. You knew, didn’t you? Apparently he’s in the hospital.”

lines.japanese: 「入院！？　何があったの？」
lines.english: “The hospital?! What happened?”

lines.japanese: 「さー知らねー。見舞いにでも行ってくればあ？　ぷくく、いやあ和馬クン心配だなあ」
lines.english: “No idea. Why don’t you pay him a visit? Pfft. Oh, poor Kazuma. I’m so worried.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね。気持ちは分かるよ。うん分かった、教えてくれてありが……」
lines.english: “Right. I know how you feel. All right, thanks for telling—”

lines.japanese: 彼は忙しかったらしく、僕の言葉を最後まで聞いていなかった。こんど会ったらちゃんとお礼を言っておこう。
lines.english: He seemed to be busy; he did not listen to the end of my sentence. I would thank him properly the next time we met.

lines.japanese: それにしても森里君はどうして入院したんだろう。
lines.english: Still, why had Morisato been hospitalized?

lines.japanese: 大きな病気じゃなければいいけど、お見舞いに行ったら怒るかな。彼の好きなサッカーの話、蛎崎うにの新譜情報、柳木原の乱闘事件。語りたいことはたくさんあるんだ。
lines.english: I hoped it was nothing serious. Would he be angry if I visited? There were so many things I wanted to discuss with him: the soccer he loved, news of Uni Kakizaki’s latest record, the brawl in Yanagihara.

lines.japanese: でも森里君は、やっぱりＨ組のひとに心配されてた。彼はこのクラスでも人気者なんだ。それなのに僕の相手なんかしてくれて、本当になんていいひとなんだろう。
lines.english: The people in Class H were worried about Morisato after all. He was popular even in this class. Yet he still took the time to keep me company. What an exceptionally kind person he was.

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: *May peace prevail on Earth*.

lines.japanese: 教室に戻ると、女子数人の派手な笑い声が聞こえた。僕がＨ組へ行っている間に、高内さんたちのグループが登校してきたみたいだ。
lines.english: When I returned to the classroom, the raucous laughter of several girls greeted me. Takauchi’s group seemed to have arrived while I was visiting Class H.

lines.japanese: 大きな声っていうのは対象を問わず、人を萎縮させる効果があるのかもしれない。僕はまた俯きながら自分の席へ戻った。
lines.english: Loud voices might have the power to cow a person, regardless of whom they addressed. Head lowered once more, I returned to my seat.

lines.japanese: 「はーねだー！」
lines.english: “Hane-daaa!”

lines.japanese: しかし座った途端に呼ばれた。高内さんが手招きしている。よかった、今日の彼女たちは機嫌がいいみたいだ。
lines.english: But the moment I sat down, she called me over. Takauchi was beckoning. Thank goodness. She and her friends appeared to be in good spirits today.

lines.japanese: そうか、きっと月曜の朝は週の始めだから、みんな気持ちがいいんだ。釣られて僕まで笑顔になってくる。
lines.english: Of course. Monday morning marked the beginning of a new week, so naturally everyone felt wonderful. Their mood drew a smile from me too.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう」
lines.english: “Good morning.”

lines.japanese: 「あん？　ああ、はよ」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh. Morning.”

lines.japanese: 「あんさ、今日の昼休み、ちょっと時間とって文集制作のクラス会議やるから」
lines.english: “Listen, we’re holding a class meeting about the graduation anthology during lunch today, so keep some time open.”

lines.japanese: 「え、ああそう……あ、それじゃ担任に言っとかないと」
lines.english: “Oh. All right… We should tell our homeroom teacher.”

lines.japanese: 「もう恩ティーには言っといた」
lines.english: “Already told O-T.”

lines.japanese: 「え、高内さんが言ってくれたの？」
lines.english: “You told her, Takauchi?”

lines.japanese: 「私じゃなきゃ誰が言うんだよ。つかさ、あんた委員長なんだから、そんくらいのこと率先してどんどんやってよね」
lines.english: “Who else would? You’re the class rep, aren’t you? Start taking the initiative on basic stuff like that.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、そうだよね、ごめん」
lines.english: “You’re right. I’m sorry.”

lines.japanese: 僕は自分の怠慢を恥ずかしく思った。そういえば学級委員としての仕事のことなんて、きのう高内さんたちと別れたっきり欠片も思いかえさなかった。
lines.english: I was ashamed of my own negligence. Come to think of it, since parting from Takauchi and the others yesterday, I had not given so much as a scrap of thought to my duties as class representative.

lines.japanese: 僕ひとりに作業を押しつけてずるい、なんてきのうはちょっと思ってしまったけど、でも高内さんは高内さんで真面目に考えてくれてたんだ。そう、それだ。
lines.english: Yesterday I had briefly thought it unfair of them to force all the work onto me. But Takauchi had been taking the matter seriously in her own way. Yes. That had to be it.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう高内さん。じゃあ昼の会議はおれが進めるよ」
lines.english: “Thank you, Takauchi. I’ll lead the meeting at lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、やる気じゃん羽田ァ！　うちらも協力すッからがんばれーい」
lines.english: “Whoa, look who’s motivated! We’ll help too, Haneda. Give it your best!”

lines.japanese: 「うん。あと、あの、きのう──」
lines.english: “I will. And, um, about yesterday—”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「──きのうのことも、ごめん。おれが間違ってたのに、高内さんのせいにしちゃって」
lines.english: “—I’m sorry about that too. I was wrong, but I blamed you.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　あァ、んーな、もういいから。そんかし、きのう決めたそっち担当の仕事、よろしくね」
lines.english: “Oh. Yeah, well, forget it. Just make sure you handle the work we assigned you yesterday.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、まかせて。おれ、がんばるよ」
lines.english: “Leave it to me. I’ll do my best.”

lines.japanese: 僕は力強く答えた。快く許してくれるなんて、普段は怖い高内さんにも優しいところがあるんだ。昼休みの会議は、汚名を返上するためにがんばろう。
lines.english: I answered with conviction. Even frightening Takauchi had a gentle side: she forgave me readily. At the lunch meeting, I would work hard to redeem myself.

lines.japanese: 自分の席へ戻ると、また彼女たちの笑い声が弾けた。みんなが楽しそうだと僕も嬉しい。みんなが楽しければそれでいいじゃないか。
lines.english: When I returned to my seat, their laughter burst out again. If everyone was happy, that made me happy too. As long as everyone was having fun, what else mattered?

lines.japanese: 遠くに高内さんたちの楽しそうなはしゃぎ声が聞こえる。
lines.english: From far away came the sound of Takauchi and her friends laughing merrily.

lines.japanese: きっと今日はいい日だ。そんな気がした。
lines.english: Today would surely be a good day. I could feel it.

lines.japanese: 「チャコ、おまえすごいわー。そこまでアメとムチ使いわけられちゃうと、いっそ清々しいわ」
lines.english: “Chako, you’re incredible. That was such a perfect carrot-and-stick routine it was almost refreshing.”

lines.japanese: 「あいつお礼まで言ってたもん。あんたマジ外道」
lines.english: “He actually thanked you. Girl, you are evil.”

lines.japanese: 「ハア？　なんでよ、向こうもやる気ンなってんじゃん。問題なくね？　つか逆に善行じゃね？」
lines.english: “What? Why? He’s motivated now, isn’t he? No problem. If anything, I did a good deed.”

lines.japanese: 「とかゆって、おまえ刺されンのが怖くなったんじゃねーの！　だっせー、きゃはは」
lines.english: “Says you. You just got scared he might stab you! What a loser! Ahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「つか、これでチャコに惚れたら超うけるー！」
lines.english: “Oh my God, imagine if this makes him fall for Chako!”

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんなテメ、冗談でもキショいこと言ってんじゃねーよ！」
lines.english: “Screw you! Don’t even joke about something that gross!”
